learning_objective: 🎯 Let us become time detectives! We will learn how to read timelines and find clues from the past using ancient objects, old coins, and books.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: History is like a long continuous story. To understand when things happened, we use a timeline. We divide years into BCE (Before Common Era) and CE (Common Era).
These are physical clues buried under the ground! Archaeologists dig up old pots, tools, coins, and weapons. These items tell us how people lived thousands of years ago.
Before printing machines existed, people wrote by hand on palm leaves or tree bark. These hand-written books are called manuscripts. They contain stories, rules, and poems of the past.
Sometimes kings wanted their orders to stay forever, so they carved them on hard surfaces like rocks, pillars, or metal plates. These permanent carvings are called inscriptions.

fun_activity.title: 📏 Draw Your Personal Timeline
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a straight line on a paper. Mark the year you were born at the start. Then, mark important events like your first day of school, getting a pet, or moving to a new house up to the present year!

quick_recap: ⭐ History dates are counted using BCE (Before Common Era) and CE (Common Era).
⭐ We learn about the past from buried objects (artefacts) and written records (manuscripts).
⭐ Inscriptions are writings carved on hard surfaces like stones and metal.
